messages:
Maya: quick sync \u2014 launching the micro-sprint social plan. priorities = webinar signups, benchmark narrative (data story), and clean SDR handoff for high-intent replies.
Zoe: love it. audience split? devs on X, PMs/decision-makers on LinkedIn? also want to test time-of-day for CTAs.
Raj: yes split. proposing microthreads for X (3 tweets each) focusing on: 1) perf wins, 2) cost story, 3) engineering tradeoffs. LinkedIn gets a single longpost + carousel.
Maya: timeline: Day 0 teaser, Day 2 benchmark thread, Day 4 webinar push, Day 5 customer microquotes, Day 7 follow-up nurture. keep paid boost for top performing post only.
Sam: routing specifics: every webinar CTA must add utm_source=x_social or utm_source=linkedin and utm_campaign=may_launch_v2. Webhook rule: if utm_campaign=="may_launch_v2" -> route to Webinar_SDR queue. For replies, detect exact phrases: "Interested demo", "Book call", or a DM with form completion. Tag signups as "webinar_signup" and set lead_score=50+. Example webhook payload we expect: 
```
{
  "event":"signup",
  "email":"user@example.com",
  "utm_source":"x_social",
  "utm_campaign":"may_launch_v2",
  "tags":["webinar_signup"]
}
```
I'll run a curl test and paste results.
Sam: curl test -> 200 OK, routing to Webinar_SDR confirmed. sample log: `200 OK -> queued: Webinar_SDR (lead_score=50)`
Zoe: creative ask: thumbnails  use the benchmark graph for X clips (fast read), product UI for LinkedIn carousel. Need aspect variants (1:1 for IG repurpose).
Raj: copy A/B for the benchmark thread:
A) Data-first (X): "Latency 3x faster. Cost per token 2x lower. The optimizations we shipped to make inference production-ready. Webinar Thurs 11am PT. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_launch_v2"
B) Engineer-led (X): "From prototype to 100k qps: the engineering checklist that made inference reliable. Live demo + tradeoffs in our webinar. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_launch_v2"
Maya: put A as control, B as variant. LinkedIn gets a single hybrid longpost mixing story + checklist.
SocialBot: schedule preview created: https://redwood.social/schedule/preview/5799997777  items=5 posts, clips=3, carousels=1. Reaction :white_check_mark:.
Zoe: I'll do thumbnails and one short trailer (30s). Raj will gather two customer microquotes for Day 5.
Sam: follow-ups: SDR triage window = 24hrs for high-intent replies. After that, move to nurture. Also adding tweet_id -> intake record so SDRs have contextual reply history.
Maya: blockers?
Raj: need final copy by tomorrow 10am, creative assets by EOD, webhook test logs posted here when done.
Zoe: brand has one quick note on font size for thumbnails  will post in Figma.
Maya: perfect. final sign-off sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. :rocket:
